sections.value:
ROUND 1 security PASS for PR #261 at 549bb717d539bd8bb37a981274497d18d7a217af.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No vulnerabilities found | - |

The security-review specialist reported no vulnerabilities after a bounded static review scoped to the executable seams PIJ_COPILOT_UPDATE_CMD and PIJ_COPILOT_SDK_CONTRACT_CMD, launch/path/argument handling, environment inheritance, report parsing, the contract refactor and --record target/content, and public-file privacy. No introduced injection or permission-laundering vulnerability was reported. C33 applies: same-user control of environment-provided executables is trusted, not a separate per-seat security boundary.

Validation: exact detached HEAD verified clean. just pr-freeze 261 returned FINAL with remote/GitHub head agreement, main base, CLEAN merge, ready, unchanged migration numbering and passing CI check (22), check (24), rust-lint, rust-test and Delivers. just copilot-sdk-contract, without an outer nice and without --record, exited 0 with all seven checks passing on installed Copilot 1.0.114-0. The expected identity-not-ready tool response was returned. harness/copilot-sdk-verified.json had identical git blob hash fda21a065b553fe6f35affc5e4e250fd447c0a58 before/after; git status remained clean and target/ remained absent.

The updater recipe/script and real copilot update were NEVER invoked. No builds, cargo commands, dependency installations or local updater test/mutation runs were performed. --record write behavior and updater failure-path guarantees were reviewed statically, not exercised against the shared fleet CLI. This is a security-only verdict, not permission to update or reload the fleet.
